rationale: Despite the broader market extending its decline (SPY -1.29%), EC continues to demonstrate strong relative strength by holding above its rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.57) and well above session VWAP ($13.41). The pullback since entry occurred on very light 1-minute volume compared to the prior breakout candle and found support right at the $13.56–$13.57 level before curling back up to $13.59. With the entry thesis intact and the $13.52 invalidation level comfortably unbroken, holding allows room for breakout continuation above the $13.65 session high.
